name: Nullweave HornSpace UV Wrap Hood
description: Lightweight UPF-55 drape hood in translucent cream-white synth-silk, cut with wide horn-passage apertures reinforced in soft silicone edging that won't snag on keratin or synthetic horn bases. Drapes loosely over the head and neck, blocking UV while venting heat through the open crown structure. Minimal construction — almost no weight — designed specifically for geneware-modified individuals who overheat at the skull.
functionality: UPF-55 UV protection, silicone-lined horn clearance, open-crown ventilation for heat release.
what_it_says: You have horns, you're out in the summer sun, and you found the one thing that actually fits.
worn_by: geneware-modified individuals with horns or cranial modifications
story_hooks: The silicone edging on the left horn passage is slightly wider — someone had it modified for an unusual horn curve.
In certain UV light, a faint pattern emerges in the synth-silk weave: a repeating glyph with no clear origin.

physical_description.visual_profile: A ethereal, nearly translucent drape that sits like a second skin over the head and neck. The cream-white material catches light softly, creating an almost spectral silhouette. Wide, carefully sculpted openings frame the sides of the face where horns or synthetic cranial extensions would emerge. The overall effect is both protective and exposed — vulnerable yet practical.
physical_description.fit: Loose, draped construction with zero compression. Sits weightlessly on the shoulders and drapes across the crown without constraint. The horn apertures are generously sized to accommodate various growth patterns without tension or binding.
physical_description.primary_material: Translucent synth-silk with high-performance UPF-55 UV-blocking nano-weave. Deliberately chosen for minimal thermal mass to prevent heat buildup at the augmented skull.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slippery synth-silk with a slight luminescent sheen. The silicone edging around the horn passages has a soft, tacky feel — designed to be non-irritating against keratin or chrome-plated synthetic horns.
physical_description.color_scheme: Translucent cream-white as primary. The fabric has a milky, opalescent quality in certain lights. Soft silicone trim in matching off-white or translucent finish. Minimal contrast — the garment is designed to be understated.
physical_description.closures: None. Pure drape construction. Sits in place through weight distribution and the natural contours of the wearer's modified head structure.
distinctive_features: Horn-passage apertures reinforced with soft silicone edging to prevent snagging
Open crown structure for passive heat venting
Translucent construction allowing visibility of hair, scalp, or synthetic cranial modifications
Nullweave branding — likely subtle, possibly woven into the fabric itself
Asymmetrical drape that accounts for uneven horn growth or placement
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 hybrid. The bespoke engineering and biomodification-specific design suggests corpo or mid-tier accessibility, but the minimalist construction keeps it affordable for practical working-class use.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by geneware-modified individuals who've undergone cranial augmentation — commonly seen in genetic modification communities, diaspora populations embracing visible body modification, and individuals in roles where thermal regulation matters (outdoor work, industrial, research). Signals pragmatism over fashion, but also a degree of body autonomy and accepted difference.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or gently broken-in. The material shows minimal wear due to its non-porous construction. May develop subtle creasing from repeated draping but resists actual damage. Very rarely patched — more likely to be replaced than repaired.
